plugin.name: Virtual Pet
plugin.description: Care for a persistent desktop companion with health, mess, sickness, growth, and gentle everyday interactions.
config.showStats.label: Show stats panel
config.showStats.description: Show the Food, Energy, Play, and Bond or Health panel next to your pet. Turn off to hide it and free up screen space.
config.classicLifecycle.label: Classic lifecycle
config.classicLifecycle.description: Allow prolonged neglect or untreated sickness to end the current pet life. Off by default; casual mode never permanently loses your pet.
config.sound.label: Action sound
config.sound.description: Optionally play a sound for direct care actions like feeding, playing, petting, cleaning, medicine, or resting.
command.feed.title: Feed snack
command.feed.description: Feed your pet a snack. Sick pets need medicine first.
command.play.title: Play game
command.play.description: Play a quick game. Sick pets need medicine first.
command.pet.title: Pet
command.nap.title: Let rest
command.nap.description: Let your pet rest for 15 minutes.
command.clean.title: Clean up
command.clean.description: Clean your pet's space and restore a little health.
command.medicine.title: Give medicine
command.medicine.description: Treat sickness. Two doses cure it.
command.status.title: Check on pet
command.status.description: Check how your pet is feeling.
command.restart.title: Start a new life
command.restart.description: Hatch a fresh companion after a classic-lifecycle death.
speech.medicine.notNeeded: I don't need medicine right now.
speech.medicine.firstDose: That helped. One more dose should do it.
speech.blocked.sick: I feel too sick for that. Could I have medicine?
speech.blocked.dead: This life has ended. Start a new life when you're ready.
speech.restart.done: A new little buddy has arrived!
speech.stage.companion: I feel like a true companion now.
speech.stage.beloved: Our bond has become something special.
speech.status.dead: This life has ended. You can start a new one.
speech.status.sick: I'm sick and need two doses of medicine.
nudge.dead: This life has ended. Start a new one when you're ready.
nudge.sick: I don't feel well. Could I have medicine?
nudge.dirty: Could you clean up my space?
